TERRESTRIAL PLANET / PLANET 03

Small facts. Big discoveries.

01

An ocean planet

Water covers about 71% of Earth’s surface. Those oceans help distribute heat and support a remarkable variety of life.

02

A moving surface

Earth’s crust is divided into slowly moving plates. Over immense spans of time, they build mountains and rearrange continents.

03

A magnetic light show

Charged particles interacting with Earth’s magnetic environment and atmosphere produce the shimmering auroras.
